feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 September 2026 9:29pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 11 September 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Ridge across the area will soon decline, with Atlantic fronts arriving later tonight.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 or 7 overnight, although staying a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay. Veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow afternoon, then Northwest 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough overnight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow afternoon, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle later tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, soon decreasing 2 or 3, backing Southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
